summary: Minimal generic LRU cache, plain C# with no Unity dependency.
overview: A least-recently-used cache: reading an entry marks it most recent, and adding past capacity evicts the oldest through a callback so the caller decides what eviction means — destroying a texture, closing a handle. Used by StreamingAssetLoader but with no dependency on it, so it is testable and reusable standalone.
useCases: Bounding memory for anything loaded on demand.
Caching expensive computations with a hard ceiling.
Unit-testable caching logic outside a scene.

gotchas.title: Eviction is your callback's job
gotchas.body: The cache drops the reference; it does not know a Texture2D needs destroying. Nothing is freed unless onEvicted does it.

gotchas.title: TryGet counts as a use
gotchas.body: That is what makes it LRU rather than FIFO, and it means a read can change what gets evicted next.
